Cracked Spines  ·  November 2026 Poll  ·  7 ballots
Sapiens drew the widest spread of opinion we've had — the section one member named as the best of the book was the section another named as the worst. Harari, for his part, did not attend, so our sharpest criticisms and open questions remain unanswered.
Endurance takes November.
Thirteen candidates, seven ballots, and the first dead heat at the top the club has had to actually break — one head-to-head vote decided the winner.
All — seven of you ranked thirteen candidates this round. Endurance (Lansing) and Say Nothing (Keefe) finished level on 58 points, so for the first time the tiebreaker settled the winner rather than a placing. The Condorcet head-to-head went to Endurance 4–3, and it reads November.
Outcome Winner: Endurance (58, on the head-to-head)   ·   Runner-up: Say Nothing (58)   ·   Relegated: Arrowsmith, Nothing Like It in the World, The Gales of November

§ About that tie
Endurance and Say Nothing both finished on 58 points — a genuine dead heat for first. The methodology calls for a Condorcet head-to-head: ignore everything else on the ballot and ask how each voter ranked these two against one another.
Head-to-head
Endurance 4 · Say Nothing 3
Four of seven put Endurance above Say Nothing, so Endurance takes November on the head-to-head. This is as close as our method can get without breaking: one voter switching the pair reverses the whole result. Say Nothing stays on the candidate list at full strength and starts December as the book to beat.
